humanevalfix.sampling: Four equal strata of 41 tasks by buggy source byte length (task name breaks ties); take the three smallest seeded SHA-256 ranks in each stratum. All tasks have equal 3/41 inclusion probability under the recorded hash-rank design.
humanevalfix.selection_reason: Largest already-materialized homogeneous lightweight Python code-repair registry benchmark: 164 reference-bearing CPU tasks with one editable Python file, common Python 3.12 image, 1 CPU/2 GiB and 600-second task deadlines. SWE-bench pools need large per-task images; math/MCQ benchmarks do not exercise reference-code mutation. This is not an exhaustive claim that no other public registry benchmark has more eligible tasks.

tb21.own_sampling: Purposive two-stratum pilot: one executable Python submission and one structured-data submission, disjoint from the 20 live Traces tasks. Not a random population estimate.
